head: OTO Camera takes finished photos with almost nothing to set
dek: OTO lets you pick a look and take the photo; each shot is developed in that look, with its own colour, tone and texture, and saved to your library finished. It was #63 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $5, by Zachariah Creative.
means: If you want a nice look without editing, it does it as you shoot.
todo: Find OTO Camera in the App Store.
